output:
To: timeline:rosario.bautista
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: none

PIN NUMBER RECEIVED!!! 🎉🙏❤️ @Lorna Villaruz, my best friend and my sister from another mother, YOU DID IT!!! Today, 9 November 2026, your NMC PIN finally came through and you are now officially a registered nurse in the UK!! I am so happy I cannot even type properly haha. Thank you Lord!

After 20 years of me saying, “Lorna, come to the UK na!” you are really coming to Liverpool. I think I can retire from convincing you now 😂

We trained together in nursing school in Iloilo, and look at us at our capping ceremony in 1996 — same hairstyle, same white shoes, same big dreams. In our dorm we polished those white shoes every single night. And everybody please take note: Lorna always borrowed MY shoe polish because she never bought her own. Almost 30 years later, I still want to know why haha. Perhaps I should put shoe polish on her arrival list beside the dried mangoes 😂

When I left for the UK in 2004, you cried at the airport and told me, “Susunod ako, I will follow you.” Well, 22 years later, it is happening! You kept your promise, mare. From your years of hard work in Riyadh and then Dubai, almost 18 years in total, through all the papers, IELTS, CBT, OSCE in Nottingham and the waiting, waiting, waiting — look where you are now. I even sent you that photo of the rain so you would know exactly what you were getting into. That is true friendship haha.

So everybody, here are the important dates! Lorna is flying from Dubai to Manchester on 14 January 2027, arriving around 1pm. Then on 25 January 2027 she starts work on Ward 7 Medical at Mersey Bank Hospital, with induction first and then her preceptorship. Ward 7, you are so lucky to have her! She is the best nurse I know — so calm, so caring, and patients simply love her. Liverpool, you are gaining a wonderful nurse and an even more wonderful person.

And yes, Lorna, you are staying with us for your first month. The spare room will be ready, with the heater and the thick duvet because I know you will freeze! I asked Ben and he said OK, so no more asking if you are really sure haha. Tito Ben is ready for his Bicol pili too.

Now one very important public service announcement: BRING A PROPER WINTER COAT. Not a light jacket, not something just nice for photos — a proper coat! If you do not have one, we are going straight to Primark or TK Maxx. The Liverpool wind is no joke, especially when you are waiting for the bus and questioning all your decisions 😂

Welcome to our Filipino family here, mare! Christmas parties with too much food, karaoke, all the aunties asking if you have eaten, and Simbang Gabi with us next year. You have so many people here ready to welcome you.

From our Iloilo dorm and those polished white shoes to Liverpool in 2027 — what a journey! I am so, so proud of you. Now pack that coat and come already. I have waited 20 years and I have the shoe polish ready 😂

WELCOME HOME, LORNA!!! I love you, my best friend! 🙏🎉❤️
